facts: Porch & Party is a Memphis-area company that decorates seasonal porches, sets up party, birthday and hotel-room decor, styles grazing tables and rents party games.
Porch & Party serves Memphis, Germantown, Collierville, Bartlett, Lakeland, Arlington, Southaven, Olive Branch, Cordova, Millington, Oakland, Horn Lake and Hernando.
Memphis, Germantown, Collierville, Bartlett, Lakeland, Arlington, Southaven and Olive Branch have no travel fee; anywhere further is a flat $75 travel fee, shown on the quote up front.
Fall / Halloween porch packages start at: Stoop $350, Classic $550, Grand $750 and Showstopper $1,200; the pumpkins and mums are yours, and takedown is a flat $75 if you want it cleared away.
Winter / Christmas porch packages start at: Stoop $450, Classic $750, Grand $1,050 and Showstopper $1,600, and January takedown is included.
Booking fall and Christmas porches together saves 10% on the Christmas package.
Every porch package includes a design made for your porch, all the decor brought to you and setup by Porch & Party; the final price is confirmed after a quick look at the porch.

Celebration setups for homes and hotel rooms (birthdays, surprises, anniversaries, proposals) start at $300; $300 to $500 buys simple decor and $1,000 and up is very heavy decor that fills the whole room.
Hotel room setup packages start at Basic $300, Luxury $500 and Signature $1,500; they use LED candles and tea lights, and hotel takedown is optional at $75 and included with Signature.
For a hotel room setup, Porch & Party generally needs to be there from 3 to 6 PM, around check-in time.
Grazing table styling starts at $250 for a board, $400 for a small table (4 to 6 ft), $650 for a full table (8 ft and up) and $500 for each additional table.
Grazing table food is not included by default: food sourcing is available for an additional fee, quoted separately once the menu and headcount are confirmed.

Giant yard game rentals are $40 a game a day or $60 for the weekend (Friday, Saturday and Sunday), with bundles from $85 and no minimum order; an inflatable movie screen is $50 a day or $75 a weekend.
Party game rentals are picked up and returned at Mt. Moriah Station, Memphis Police Department, with a government photo ID; a business can have them delivered for $20.
Rentals are held with a $50 refundable damage deposit plus 50% of the rental fee.

Porch, party and room decor and grazing tables are held with 50% of the quote; cancel 48 hours or more before and the deposit comes back in full, and rain or a storm moves the date free within 30 days.
Payment is by Zelle or Cash App only.

Customers request online at porchandparty901.com/request (about three minutes, no account needed) or call or text 901-355-1518, and Porch & Party replies within one business day with what is open on the date and the total.
Nothing is held until the deposit is in; every final quote depends on the date, the city and how much is being styled.
lacks: Porch & Party does not put up Christmas lights.
Porch & Party does not take cards or cash.
Porch & Party does not deliver party game rentals to homes; only a business can have them delivered.
Porch & Party does not rent chairs.
Porch & Party does not use open-flame candles in hotel rooms.
Porch & Party does not sell a takedown-only visit for decor it did not set up.
Porch & Party does not include food in a grazing table price unless food sourcing is quoted separately.
